verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships a global CLI covering projects, loops, intentions, stories and tasks that is explicitly meant to run from "anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron." Every command takes a stable, additive-only `--json` output, and per-integration API keys plus a streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint allow headless, scriptable access. It also posts automated GitHub checks on PRs, with an opt-in failure threshold. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), documented non-interactive auth such as env-var API key usage for the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
